build_learner: build an example learner with init, train, and predict callbacks using build_example_learner
init_state: initialize an ExampleLearnerState instance by calling the init function
train_learner: train the example learner on a dataset and return resource usage metrics
predict_classification: predict zero-filled outputs for classification or multi-label classification tasks using predict
prepare_learner_for_launchpad: prepare the learner to run on launchpad using learner_builder with a dataset lookup builder
